canonical_name: Alternate Work Site Security Not Addressed
description: Security controls for alternate work sites such as home offices are not implemented or verified. This signal indicates that CUI may be processed in environments without adequate physical protection.
applicability: Applicable to all remote and alternate work locations. Includes home office security, remote work environments, and temporary work locations accessing CUI.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through remote work policy review, alternate site security verification, and telework agreement assessment.
